title: AI Engineer, Agent Analytics & Optimization
requirements:
US Foster City / Bay Area preferred (California OK). PRIORITY HIRE — production AI Engineer, NOT Product Builder, NOT research, NOT prompt-engineering-only.

Core job: build systems so AI agents can understand, query, and act on Conviva behavioral data — MCP servers, agentic workflows, AI connectors to clients/downstream systems. Own build + runtime at scale (Product Builders own discovery/roadmap).

Must have (3–7+ yrs SWE):
- Python backend services shipped end-to-end (design → deploy → monitor); fullstack a plus
- LLM-powered agents IN PRODUCTION with concrete failure/fix stories
- MCP servers or equivalent tool-use / AI connector integrations (auth, scoping, access control)
- Agentic patterns: tool use, structured outputs, prompt chaining, multi-agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop when needed; knows when deterministic workflows win
- Evals to validate agent behavior + catch regressions
- Observability/tracing (Langfuse, LangSmith, OpenTelemetry, or homegrown)
- Cloud (GCP/AWS), containers, async Python

Bonus: LangGraph, Anthropic SDK, Pydantic-AI, CrewAI; digital experience analytics / APM; LLM-ops; published OSS/talks at eng∩AI.

Score HIGH when: MCP/tool servers, production agents, evals+tracing, Python services.
Score LOW / DISQUALIFY: pure PM; tutorial/student/bootcamp; agents only in demos; no tool-use/MCP evidence; research-only papers without shipping.
